title: Introduce cohorted release drafts and provenance-hash for per-slice release notes
author: Maya Chen
release_notes: Introduce an automated pathway to generate draft release notes per cohort (slice) with an injected provenance-hash and a stability gate. Adds CLI/UI preview and a lightweight summary algorithm for compact notes. Backwards compatible: existing changelog pipeline consumes cohort drafts or falls back to the aggregate note.
description: Motivation: Product and SRE teams have asked for per-cohort release notes so stakeholders can review model behavior across important slices (e.g., high-length prompts, low-resource languages, latency-sensitive clients). This PR adds a draft generator that emits one compact draft per configured cohort along with a compact provenance-hash that ties the draft to: model-version, profile-hash, dataset-snapshot-id, and the seed prompt set. Each draft includes a short perf summary, top-3 regression signals, and suggested mitigations.

review_comments: Arjun Patel (2025-01-10): Could you expand on how the provenance-hash is computed? We need deterministic hashes for audit. — Response: The hash is HMAC-SHA256 over canonicalized keys: model_version, profile_hash, dataset_snapshot_id, seed_prompt_set_id. The key used for HMAC is stored encrypted in the release service (referenced in docs).

Lena Gomez (2025-01-11): The stability gate thresholds are hardcoded; request to move to config and expose via Console. — Response: Moved thresholds into release-config; Console flag added (docs updated).

Tomás Rivera (2025-01-12): Tests flaked on CI (race in snapshot loader). Suggest sleeping or retry with backoff. — Response: Added a retry with exponential backoff in tests and guarded the loader path; CI run passed afterwards.
Arjun Patel (2025-01-13): Approving pending minor wording on CLI help text. — Response: Updated CLI help and man page text per comment.
merge_result: squash and merged by Lena Gomez on 2025-01-15. Merge commit includes: a compact summary for cohort drafts, CLI commands, and docs. Rollout strategy: feature-flagged (release.cohort_drafts) toggled off by default for accounts with >100k predictions until we complete canary run.
usage_and_rollout: How to preview: registry-cli release preview --model my-model --version v1 --cohort high-length
How to publish drafts: registry-cli release publish --draft-id <id>  (blocked if stability_gate fails)
Console: new 'Cohort drafts' tab on model history page (behind flag)
Safety: drafts include provenance-hash and are written to audit log with read-only ACL for release curators
